digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center token bucket rate limiting (429 responses) is not retried by the current transport layer and propagates as immediate hard failure
Retry-After header from 429 responses must be honored on opted-in idempotent read call sites with jitter applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S

The opt-in retry flag must be threaded through both _paged_search/_call_logged (PATH A) and direct _with_connection_retry calls like get_comment_map's per-issue fetch (PATH B) to cover all high-volume reads
Mutation call sites (create_issue, add_comment, etc.) must NOT retry 429 responses to prevent duplicate writes when errors arrive after server begins processing
Four specific read call sites must opt into rate-limit retry: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's paged search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, and get_parent_map
